annotations.title: Request a hotline call (incl. waiting on hold)

description: Request that we call a hotline or authority, wait on hold, and obtain an answer or complete a simple request on behalf of an authorised account holder. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 19 up to 30 minutes incl. hold time, then EUR 0.50 per minute.

account_holder_name.description: Optional: account holder (required for account-specific matters).

authorization_confirmed.description: True if the account holder has authorised us to act for this matter.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
